title: ตู้ข้างเตียง
statusNotes: Blender master + low-poly done; low-poly used in #/showcase. Not yet used by the in-room scene (still the hand-coded builder; room data size is 0.5 x 0.52 x 0.42 m).
dimensionsNotes: From the camera solve on the mock-up with height fixed at 55 cm. X = width, Y = depth, Z = height in Blender (Z-up); glTF/Three is Y-up with the front facing +Z. Detailed part sizes in blender/dims.json. boundingBoxCm is the exported model's full bounding box in Blender axes (origin at the floor centre of the carcass); depth is 43 cm overall because the knob sticks out 2.5 cm at the front (−Y). tools/import_external.py fits external models to this box.
style: stylised low-poly game prop, warm light wood, flat shading, no visible grain in the low-poly

source.cropBoxNotes: Pixels in the mock-up, top-left origin. The crop is identical to games/never-ending-story/public/showcase/nightstand-ref.png (template match score 1.0).

exports.partNodesNote: One mesh node per part under a root node (Nightstand_Master / Nightstand_LowPoly), origin at part centre; used by #/editor.

notes: The dark vertical post at the left of the crop is the bed, not part of this asset.
The white/cream block at the far left is the bed's mattress and pillow, not part of this asset.
Wall, skirting board and plank floor are background, not part of this asset.
The table has one drawer with a small rectangular knob, four square legs, side stretchers on the left and right only (no front or back stretcher).

v0.2.4: side stretchers enlarged to 4.5 x 7 cm (z 11-18 cm) so they read clearly; the drawer-bottom board that showed below the back apron was removed. The table now has no board between the back legs.
The right side frame is open between the apron and the stretcher (you can see the wall through it).
The lighter band across the top is painted shading in the mock-up, not separate planks; it is not modelled.
The mock-up crop is only 252 x 284 px; the 1024 square images are upscaled and soft.
